title: 1RB0LC_1LA1RF_1LD0LE_1RE0RA_1LC0RD_0RE---: every kind of collision seen is proved for all values of its gaps
text: The exact simulator runs only the collisions at the ends of the movers cell by cell. Every kind it meets up to 1.6·10<sup>18</sup> steps is now a Lean lemma with every gap a variable (20 distinct lemmas, plus a lemma for any list of swept movers at the right end), and none can halt. New shapes still turn up (two after 10<sup>15</sup> steps); no regular invariant that excludes a halting one was found (CTL by SAT up to 16×16 states, NGramCPS to width 14).
